info.title: Slath API
info.description: The Slath REST API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <personal access token>`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. Mutating requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header.

get.summary: Organizations the authenticated user belongs to.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

post.summary: Creates an organization; the caller becomes its owner (`user:write`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

put.summary: Adds a member or changes their role (owners, `user:write`).

delete.summary: Removes a member, or leaves (`user:write`). The last owner can't leave.

get.summary: Repositories the caller can see (public ones for anonymous callers).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

delete.summary:
Deletes a repository (admins, `repo:write`). It disappears at once and
can be restored by a site administrator for a few days.

get.summary: A file's content at a ref (up to the instance's render limit).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path inside the repository (default: the root).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

put.summary: Adds a collaborator or changes their role (admins).

get.summary: History of a ref, optionally limited to a path.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit ID (default: the default branch).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only commits touching this path.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: A commit with the files it changes (compared with its first parent).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: `open` (default), `closed`, or `all`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `created` (default) or `updated`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

delete.summary: Deletes a comment (own, or any for maintainers).

patch.summary: Edits an issue, or closes or reopens it (author or triage).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

post.summary: Creates the rule for a pattern, or replaces it (admins).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: The entries of a directory at a ref.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit ID (percent-encode slashes)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path inside the repository (default: the root).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

delete.summary: Removes one of the user's SSH keys (`user:write`).

get.summary: The user's personal access tokens (never the secrets; `user:read`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

post.summary: Tokens can't be created through the API, only in the web UI in sudo mode.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the user's tokens (`user:write`).

truncated.description: The change list was cut off at the instance's diff limits.

body_html.description: The description rendered for the caller (references resolved).

body.description: Empty when deleted or hidden from the caller.

namespace.description: Your username or an organization you belong to.

PostProtection.description:
Every field is optional in the JSON so that authorization runs before
validation (a missing pattern is a 422 only for those allowed to ask).

pattern.description: Glob on the short branch name (`*` doesn't cross `/`).

prefix.description: The first characters after `slath_pat_`, for recognizing the token.

name.description: A new name; the old one keeps redirecting readers.
